newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Q2 GDP up three percent - central bank.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Q2 GDP up three percent - central bank.

text.p: Belgian gross domestic product (GDP) rose three percent in the second quarter of this year compared with the first quarter, while year-on-year growth was 1.5 percent, the Belgian National Bank said on Friday.
First quarter GDP has been revised to up 1.3 percent from up 1.0 percent, the central bank said in its weekly publication "Economic Indicators for Belgium."
